svg.title: Spectrum VIII
svg.desc: Schematic visual study after the cited photograph. Approximate geometry and standardized colors; wall and cast shadows omitted. Twelve equal vertical painted panels. Twelve approximate hues retain the source sequence, grouped into color families for filtering; not colorimetric.
